title: The Good Samaritan
intro: The parable of the good Samaritan is Jesus' answer to the question, 'Who is my neighbor?' It challenges all religious boundaries and shows that love does not ask about ethnicity or religion—only about need.

items.title: What is written in the Law?
Do this and you will live
Who is my neighbor?
items.note: He wanted to limit his responsibility

items.title: The man who fell among robbers
The Samaritan stopped
items.note: Samaritans and Jews had nothing to do with each other

footer.title: The true neighbor
footer.content: Jesus turns the question around: not 'Who is my neighbor?' (whom must I help?), but 'Who was a neighbor?' (who showed love?). Love makes you a neighbor—no matter who the other person is. Go and do likewise!
